title: Recorded data for tensor projection coherence
statement: For a ringed tensor corner A as in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact], let total(A,P,Q) be the signed direct-sum total complex of P tensor Q; its associator is reassociation without a sign and its symmetry on bidegree (p,q) is the swap with coefficient (-1)^(pq). For a representative tensor model a, TensorConstraints(A,a) consists of natural associator and symmetry isomorphisms for A.tensor whose components on flat-term K-flat representatives are induced by these total-complex maps via a.representative. For ringed tensor edges, Composition, Identity and Section record ordinary inverse-image and module-pullback comparison isomorphisms compatible with scalar insertion; their Normalized predicates specify the induced derived comparison on every flat-term K-flat complex, using the canonical derived pullback comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. The right-adjoint comparisons are adjunction conjugates of the inverse left comparisons, using [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Define compositeProjection by transposing the composite tensor comparison followed by the composite counit, identityProjection by transposing the identity, leftProjection by conjugating the projection of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact] with tensor symmetry, and sectionComposite by the successive leftProjection maps with the section comparisons inserted. These are the explicit constructions in the parent projection-coherence statement; no projection equality is assumed.
